title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What was Abram's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Isaac
   B. Israel
   C. Jacob
   D. Abraham

2. Which of these shows respect for the differences among people? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving out children who look different
   B. Giving people nicknames about their bodies
   C. Laughing at how others speak
   D. Playing with children from different backgrounds

3. What rests in the branches of the tree? (1 mark)
   A. Lions
   B. Goats
   C. Snakes
   D. Birds

4. Is love only a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. Yes
   B. No, it is also a choice and action
   C. Only for adults
   D. Only in church

5. Who was stoned for standing firm in his faith? (1 mark)
   A. Andrew
   B. Paul
   C. Stephen
   D. Peter

6. What does joy mean for a Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Only laughing
   B. Being rich
   C. Having no problems
   D. Deep gladness from knowing God

7. What is joy, as a Christian understands it? (1 mark)
   A. Having lots of money
   B. Never having problems
   C. Only laughing at jokes
   D. A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us

8. Who opened the donkey's mouth? (1 mark)
   A. The Lord
   B. Balak
   C. The angel of the king
   D. Balaam

9. Whom should you tell if someone touches you in a wrong way? (1 mark)
   A. A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   B. Nobody
   C. The person who touched you
   D. A stranger

10. What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51? (1 mark)
   A. He is a liar
   B. Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   C. Let us punish Him
   D. He is a king

11. What is the New Testament mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. The kings of Israel
   B. Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   C. The Law of Moses only
   D. The creation of the world only

12. What does it mean to stand firm in faith? (1 mark)
   A. To give up
   B. To hide
   C. To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   D. To copy others

13. About how many people were baptised that day? (1 mark)
   A. Thirty
   B. Three thousand
   C. Three hundred
   D. Three

14. Which verse tells Christians to rejoice in the Lord always? (1 mark)
   A. Philippians 4:4
   B. Luke 19:5
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 1:1

15. A friend invites you to skip class and play. What is the best choice? (1 mark)
   A. Tell the teacher a lie
   B. Join him secretly
   C. Politely say no and go to class
   D. Leave school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State two ways of helping the kingdom of God to grow. (2 marks)

17. State three ways in which the first Christians lived together. (3 marks)

18. Give two ways of helping a person who is blind. (2 marks)

19. List three ways of using money wisely. (3 marks)

20. What does the name Nazirite refer to in the story of Samson? (2 marks)

21. Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Abraham
   Genesis 17:5 records the new name.

2. D — Playing with children from different backgrounds
   Respecting differences shows that we value all of God's creation.

3. D — Birds
   The birds perched in its branches.

4. B — No, it is also a choice and action
   Love is shown in actions.

5. C — Stephen
   Acts 7:54-60.

6. D — Deep gladness from knowing God
   Joy comes from God.

7. D — A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   Christian joy is based on God's love, not on our circumstances.

8. A — The Lord
   The Lord made the donkey speak.

9. A — A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult can protect you.

10. B — Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

11. B — Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   The New Testament tells about Jesus and the early church.

12. C — To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   Standing firm means not giving in.

13. B — Three thousand
   Acts 2:41.

14. A — Philippians 4:4
   Philippians 4:4 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always."

15. C — Politely say no and go to class
   Skipping class is wrong and harms learning.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good example, prayer, inviting friends to church, sharing Bible stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: They learned the teaching, prayed, ate together, shared with the needy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Greet them by name, offer to guide, include them, do not tease.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Save some, spend on needs first, give to those in need, avoid wasting, do not steal or cheat, keep a record.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A person set apart for God from birth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set apart and 1 mark for for God.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
